description: This file defines the Shipping controller class for the OpenCart admin extension. It handles the display and saving of shipping total settings in the admin panel, including rendering views, managing permissions, and updating configuration.

classes.name: Shipping
classes.description: Controller class for managing shipping total settings within the OpenCart admin extension.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the shipping total settings page, loads language, sets breadcrumbs, prepares data, and renders the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles form submission to save shipping total settings, manages permissions, and returns JSON response.
